title: Coulomb Stress-Shadow, Sub-Smectite MT-Gravity, Potassic Kd, Drape-Notched Magnetics, Slip-Deficit & Flank-Decontaminated Charnes-Cooper Multi-Regime Discovery
hypothesis: Fixing the 4:1 false-negative scarp-flank training contamination (d_known >= 3.0 px in far_pool and 100%-visible flank-decontaminated pure-physics head) while adding 4 new static physical transforms (H80-MT-PHASE sub-smectite conductivity x basement-depth normal colinearity, H80-DRAPE-DECONV 400 m flight-line Butterworth notch + drape-corrected magnetic wavenumber depth, H80-RADIO-KD cross-fitted potassic adularia residual Kd, H80-SLIP-DEFICIT piedmont relief junction step) and 2 strictly fold-visible elastic mechanics channels (H80-COULOMB-CFS planar Coulomb failure stress lobe/shadow and H80-SLIP-DEFICIT gap inversion) coupled with Coulomb-shadow-penalized Charnes-Cooper submodular kernel allocation improves zero-catalogue pure-physics HOLDOUT-DTI over G79-THVC EXP-79-1 (0.0784 / 0.0648), beats H33 fold-fair control (0.0961 / 0.0989) on both holdout seeds with paired 95% CIs strictly > 0, and eliminates the 0.7139 > 0.70 forward 3-px collision with live post-index GEMSDOE83 (< 0.70 across all comparable sparse <= 75,308-dot submissions in the 1,212-raster universe).
mechanism: Normal slip on segmented Great Basin faults transfers positive Coulomb failure stress (Delta CFS > 0) into forward propagation cones and 15-45 deg en-echelon relay step-overs while casting a negative stress shadow (Delta CFS < 0) across perpendicular lateral flanks (300-2500 m). Far-field unmapped faults (>1.2 km from mapped traces) express co-aligned electrical conductivity and gravity basement-depth steps beneath smectite clay caps, potassic adularia-illite alteration (+K normalized by immobile eTh) with magnetite oxidation, shallow intra-sedimentary magnetic wavenumber steps masked by 400 m E-W flight-line corrugation, and piedmont scarp steps conserving range-front footwall structural relief.
named_non_fault_process: Isotropic 200-800 m distance halos on stress-shadowed perpendicular flanks of mapped faults, pluvial Lake Lahontan/Bonneville shoreline risers, closed-basin illite/potash playas, E-W 400 m aeromagnetic tie-line leveling corrugation, incised alluvial fan channel banks, and TIGER/Line highway/railroad embankments.

experiments.name: EXP-CSMD-1_pure_zero_catalogue_decontam
experiments.description: 74-channel static physical & hydrothermal stack (zero existing_faults.tif topology features), trained across 4 spatial quadrants on 100% of fold-visible faults (vis) with 1 <= d_vis < 3.0 px scarp flanks excluded from negatives, emitted at 37,654 dots (3.0 px Poisson spacing).

experiments.name: EXP-CSMD-2_csmd_uniform_d28
